L.audio_profile: A cheerful woman of 25 with a bright, warm, quick voice; natural and unpolished, like a friend filming a vlog.

T.audio_profile: A tall, dry man of 30 with a low, casual voice; slow, proud, deadpan; he never raises his voice.

speakers.audio_profile: A cheerful woman of 25 with a bright, warm, quick voice; natural and unpolished, like a friend filming a vlog.
A tall, dry man of 30 with a low, casual voice; slow, proud, deadpan; he never raises his voice.

dialogue_turns.text: [bright, to the camera, a dare] Football. One sentence.
[slow, exact, to the camera] Ninety minutes of complaining, and one of them is the best minute of your year.
[quiet, turning to him, meaning it] ...That's actually lovely.
[at once, flat] It was an accident.

payload.scene: A phone vlog on a windy hill above a small city with a stadium far below. Wind.
payload.sample_context: A ten-second comedy moment played by two close friends on a sports trip. It must sound like two real people talking, quick and natural, never like an advert or a narrator. LUNA, about 25, is cheerful, quick and sure of herself; to her everything is good news. TIMO, about 30, is slow, dry and proud; he never raises his voice. They answer each other fast.
